description.value: Air North is Yukon's own airline, flying Vancouver to Whitehorse nonstop two or three times a day year-round, plus a daily Kelowna flight that stops in Vancouver on the way. Bikes fly for $50 plus tax, booked ahead and space available. Pack it in a hard case, or a bike box if you sign a release. Max 32 kg. E-bikes only if the battery comes out, goes in the cabin, and is 160 Wh or smaller.

Boxed bikes OK.detail: hard case preferred; bike box with signed release

Advance booking required.detail: add the bike to your booking; space available

E-bikes OK.detail: only with a removable battery of 160 Wh or less carried in the cabin
